pair_skew:eth.emc_note: Over the vendor guidance (0.51-1.27 mm) the link still works but common-mode / EMC grows (line side, after the transformer, radiates): ~-30 dB mode conversion at 25 mm. See reports/ETH skew limits line vs PHY side.md. Tune when routing allows.
pair_skew:eth.function: Link: adaptive equalisation, 25 mm = 2 % of an 8 ns symbol. Hard = 10 % symbol (physics). Guidance values are TARGET-class.
pair_skew:eth.notes: target = CM5 datasheet 'ideally'; hard = Pulse 50 mil (magnetics vendor of the part used); TI 20 mil (0.51 mm) is the tightest PHY-vendor figure. reports/ETH skew limits line vs PHY side.md
